name: SOG Volume Reader
definition: A recursive algorithm to load a hierarchical volume format (SOG) into a 3D grid, supporting internal, empty, leaf, and pseudo-leaf node types to efficiently store and retrieve volumetric data.
summary: The SOG Volume Reader is a recursive algorithm that loads hierarchical volumetric data into a dense 3D grid, distinguishing itself by reconstructing full voxel arrays from compressed octree-like structures for efficient sparse data storage.
